jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one source-grounded raster sprite for a 2D side-view Silent Hill game. Create exactly ONE complete subject, isolated on a truly transparent RGBA background. No text, UI, grid, border, watermark, panels or copies. Entire subject including all extremities and its required supports must fit inside the middle 60% of the square canvas; leave generous 20% transparent padding on ALL four sides. Moderate scale, never a close-up. Detailed but restrained original-game-like materials in soft neutral light. No cinematic glow, no extra scenery. The facing direction is RIGHT.
Reference is actual Silent Hill Origins (2007) Remnant gameplay. Recreate this exact unusual bodiless creature: a single small thin rusty irregular wire cage floating in empty air, with a flat elongated humanoid SHADOW on the ground beneath it. The cage is empty: there is NO physical human, skeleton, corpse, head, legs or person inside or below it. The shadow is a dark flat translucent projection, not an anatomical object. Match the simple uneven narrow cage outline seen at center-right of the reference, subtle rust-tan wires with the same sparse pattern; avoid decorative hooks, loops, chains, hanging limbs, padlocks, spikes or an enlarged cage. Compose as a clean RIGHT-facing lateral elevation of the whole floating cage and its grounded shadow, one supernatural subject. Keep a clear transparent vertical gap between cage and shadow. Preserve the source's emptiness and modest scale. The human-shaped shadow stretches along the horizontal ground plane to the right; it remains a restrained flat dark silhouette with no modeled volume. Do not reproduce the hospital, tiles, camera artifacts, other cages or lighting from the photograph. No added generic oval drop shadow.
jobs.limits: A 200×272 native gameplay reference establishes the empty cage and flat humanoid shadow. Wire topology, source scale and lateral shadow projection remain interpreted; no hidden anatomy or original animation is certified.

Preserve the source's very simple wedge-like silhouette, smooth cream-gray top with a few broad leathery folds, darker tan-brown tapered rear and dark underside. jobs.limits: The native bestiary reference is approximately 127 px and viewed obliquely. Right-facing horizontal presentation and relief are authored; no source scale, fine texture, opposite-side geometry or original crawling animation is certified.
